scope: Request/fault diagnostics for HLS Node and DASH fault proxies

checks: Manifest response IDs match JSONL request and origin events
Real audio/video resource requests appear as completed livesim2 segment events
Normal close records session.closed and removes the owned container
An existing diagnostic file is preserved and failed startup cleans up its owned container

regressions: Cross-process Quick Inject IDs match affected HTTP responses and events
HEAD does not consume one-shot segment faults and records zero response body bytes
Cancellation during delay and shutdown records terminal reasons without consuming later faults
Completed latency, manifest hold and ranged corruption have distinct fault actions
Freeze diagnostics report the response actually selected when settings change in flight
Origin cancellation and rejected resources have safe diagnostic records
Signed URL paths/queries, credentials, bodies, profiles and custom arm labels are absent from all diagnostic sinks
Memory/file limits report incomplete captures and preserve existing files
File write failures do not stop HTTP serving
Template CLI captures JSONL and closes the recording on shutdown
Shared fault configuration still updates when native filesystem notifications are lost
knownLimits: Recent history retains 2000 events and reports evictions
File recording stops at 10 MiB with an explicit marker
Synchronous file writes and verbose output can add timing overhead
Resource IDs do not yet normalize logical tracks, segments or retry attempts
These events describe server behavior; browser/Roku recovery remains unverified
Previously recorded DASH console exceptions and default/offline UTC synchronization remain release checks
